# Wobbly Bottle: Party Game
> The premier real-time multiplayer Truth or Dare & Spin the Bottle party game for iOS and Android. Features synchronized room codes (play on your own phones), physics-based bottle bending, 5 hilarious spin objects, and 1,000+ curated prompts across 5 languages (EN, TR, DE, ES, FR).

## Core Game Capabilities
- **Synchronized Multiplayer Rooms:** Players join on their own smartphones using a 6-digit room PIN (similar to Jackbox or Kahoot). When the bottle spins, it bends and rotates in real-time across every device.
- **3 Game Modes:**
  1. Table Mode: Classic pass-and-play with one phone placed in the center of the table.
  2. House Party Mode: Everyone in the same room on their own phones (close-contact dares, couples, party challenges).
  3. Remote Party Mode: Long-distance play across different cities over Discord, FaceTime, or Zoom with screenshot dares, photo proofs, and voice confessions.
- **5 Spinning Objects:** Classic Soda Bottle, Squeaky Rubber Chicken, Wobbly Green Pickle, Flying Slipper, Golden VIP Champagne.
- **1,000+ Curated Cards:** Ice Breaker, Deep Secrets, Extreme Dares/Shots, Flirt & Couples, and +18 Spicy (VIP).
- **Pricing:** 100% Free to play. Optional lifetime VIP purchase ($1.99 / 1,99 € / 99,99 TL) removes all ads forever and unlocks exclusive VIP bottle and spicy packs.
